prompts.title: Man Doodle Line Art Collage Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Ultra-realistic 3x3 editorial lifestyle collage featuring the same mature man 
(match the attached reference photo) portrayed in nine imaginative professions, 
hobbies, and dream scenarios. Each panel blends real photography with hand-drawn black ink doodle illustrations, as if simple sketch art has come to life around 
him. Minimalist white studio background, soft diffused lighting, subtle natural 
shadows, thin white borders separating each panel in a clean magazine-style grid. 
Hyper-realistic photography combined with fine, monochrome black ink doodles and pencil-sketch texture. Professional DSLR quality, sharp focus, photorealistic 
rendering, 8K resolution, premium commercial/editorial advertising quality.

Keep the man's facial identity, skin tone, hairstyle, sunglasses, expression, and 
natural body proportions perfectly consistent across every panel.

Panel 1 – Surfing: riding a surfboard in an energetic pose, surrounded by 
expressive black ink sketches of waves, spray, and motion lines.

Panel 2 – Astronaut: wearing a realistic NASA-style suit, floating weightlessly 
with a rocket launching beneath him, hand-drawn stars and planets around him.

Panel 3 – Reading on clouds: lying comfortably on a fluffy white cloud, 
surrounded by cozy hand-drawn study-room doodles (books, lamp, tea cup).

Panel 4 – Scientist: white lab coat, examining a glass test tube, surrounded by 
hand-drawn molecular structures, chemical formulas, bubbles, and a comic speech bubble reading "PromptPlum!"

Panel 5 – Gardener: kneeling beside a raised wooden garden bed watering fresh 
vegetable plants, surrounded by illustrated herbs, leaves, flowers, tools, and insects.

Panel 6 – Meditation: sitting cross-legged in lotus pose atop a large illustrated 
lotus flower, glowing aura circles and inspirational doodles behind him.

Panel 7 – Chef: chef's uniform, holding tomatoes and zucchini, surrounded by 
hand-drawn steam curls and kitchen doodles.

Panel 8 – Carpenter: protective gloves and safety glasses, hammering at a 
workbench, surrounded by hand-drawn tools, rulers, screws, and wood shavings.

Panel 9 – Artist: paint-splattered apron, mid-brushstroke on a landscape 
painting, surrounded by hand-drawn paint splashes, tubes, and sketch lines.

Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Colorful Scribble Art Family Portrait
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed hand-drawn scribble-art portrait using the uploaded family photo only as the reference for each person’s facial identity, age, gender, skin tone, hairstyle, and family members. Include exactly the same 3 or 4 people—do not add, remove, replace, or merge anyone. Do not copy the original pose, composition, background, or exact clothing.
Create a fresh, professionally arranged family pose. Place the entire family prominently in the center of a vertical composition, close together with warm, natural interaction. Position the parents behind or beside the children, gently leaning inward. For one child, place them centrally between or slightly in front of the parents; an infant or toddler may be held naturally. For two children of any age or gender, arrange both clearly in the center foreground or between the parents with balanced spacing and every face fully visible. Give everyone warm, natural expressions directed toward the viewer.
Restyle the family in coordinated, elegant outfits suitable for their age, gender, and cultural appearance. If the reference clothing is very simple, enhance it with richer colors, tasteful patterns, refined fabric details, subtle embroidery, layering, or appropriate accessories. The outfits should look stylish and complementary without becoming overly formal. Do not reproduce the exact original clothes.
Render the portrait using thousands of overlapping, free-flowing thin pen strokes and colorful ink scribbles in black, blue, orange, pink, purple, and red. Preserve recognizable facial features, realistic anatomy, expressive eyes, intricate crosshatching, delicate shading, and accurate proportions.
Use clean white textured paper as the background. Keep the family sharply detailed and fully defined at the center, while the outer edges of their clothing and surrounding linework gradually dissolve into loose, colorful scribbles and softly fade into the white background on both sides. Maintain balanced negative space around the centered family.
Eye-level medium family portrait, gallery-quality traditional pen-and-ink illustration, vibrant artistic energy, ultra-sharp detail, vertical composition. Aspect ratio 4:5.

prompts.title: Trending Doodle Shadow
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded character reference image as the strict identity and outfit reference. Preserve the reference character’s face identity, facial proportions, eye shape, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hair color, visible accessories, overall recognizable vibe, outfit and styling shown in the reference image

Do not hardcode any specific character traits that are not present in the uploaded reference.
All identity, hairstyle, accessories, and clothing details must be inferred directly from the uploaded reference image.

Create a high-quality mixed-style vertical portrait showing:
1. a realistic full-body version of the uploaded character/person
2. a black hand-drawn doodle-shadow version of the same character/person on the wall beside them

Core concept:
The real person and their doodle-shadow are doing a playful mischievous pose together.
The real person performs a cute realistic version of the pose, while the doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version of the same pose idea.
The mood should feel cute, playful, mischievous, stylish, funny, and social-media-friendly.

Real person:
- Must remain realistic and photogenic
- Must wear the same outfit style and key visible details from the uploaded reference image
- Do not replace the reference styling with unrelated fashion
- Expression should be cute, slightly confused, mildly embarrassed, playful, as if thinking: “Why am I doing this with my shadow?”
- The real person should not stand stiffly
- The real person should actively participate in the pose, but in a natural realistic way

Doodle-shadow:
- Must be a black hand-drawn sketch version of the same person, drawn directly on the wall
- Not a realistic second person
- Not a normal physical shadow
- Not a full-color anime character
- Black sketch line-art only
- Should resemble the person through hairstyle silhouette, accessories, outfit silhouette, and pose structure
- The doodle-shadow should look more energetic, sillier, and more chaotic than the real person
- Add manga-like motion lines, hearts, stars, sparkles, and comic marks around the doodle if helpful

Random mischievous pose rule:
The pose must NOT be fixed.
For each generation, invent a new playful mischievous pose for both the real person and the doodle-shadow.
The real person and the doodle-shadow should share the same general pose idea, but they do not need to match perfectly.
The real person performs a cute realistic version.
The doodle-shadow performs a much more exaggerated, chaotic, cartoonish version.

Do not repeatedly use pointing poses.
Do not repeatedly use finger-gun poses.
Do not repeatedly use the same standing pose.
Do not always make both figures simply point at each other.

Create a different mischievous pose each time.

Possible pose directions are loose inspiration only, not a fixed menu:
- playful idol pose
- silly dance pose
- leaning sideways with one arm curved overhead
- making a big heart pose
- cheeky wink pose
- hands near cheeks in a cute teasing pose
- exaggerated “that's it!” pose
- mock surprise pose
- playful running-in-place pose
- mischievous tiptoe pose
- arms stretched in opposite directions
- pretending to sneak away
- cute troublemaker pose
- dramatic overreaction pose
- goofy victory pose
- playful balance pose
- playful peekaboo pose
- shy but mischievous pose
- cute overconfident pose

The final pose should feel fresh, cute, mischievous, and slightly chaotic.
The real person should look like they are reluctantly playing along.
The doodle-shadow should look like it is having way too much fun.

Composition:
- vertical 3:4 or 2:3
- show the real person in full-body or nearly full-body framing
- place the real person on one side of the frame
- place the black doodle-shadow on a clean wall beside them
- the doodle-shadow should be roughly the same height or slightly taller
- keep enough space around both figures so the full pose is visible
- the connection between the real person and the doodle-shadow must be clear at a glance

Background:
- simple clean indoor studio wall or minimal room corner
- white, cream, or pale gray wall
- clean floor
- soft natural sunlight patch or gentle wall shadow allowed
- keep the background uncluttered

Lighting:
- soft natural studio lighting
- bright, clean, polished, playful mood
- keep the real person’s face clearly visible

Style quality:
- realistic human photography
- black hand-drawn doodle-shadow on wall
- matching mischievous pose interaction
- strong identity resemblance
- outfit and styling faithfully based on the uploaded reference
- cute and stylish mixed-media portrait
- clean composition
- social-media-friendly
- no obvious AI artifacts

Negative prompt:
Outfit change unrelated to reference, realistic second person, normal reflection, normal shadow only, solid black monster shadow, horror shadow, creepy shadow, full-color illustration, cartoon human, anime human, weak resemblance, unrelated sketch character, messy wall, cluttered background, repeated pointing pose, repeated finger-gun pose, same pose every time, fixed pose, boring mirrored pose, stiff pose, identical pose repetition, real person not matching shadow pose, text, watermark, logo, distorted body, extra limbs, extra fingers, bad hands.

prompts.title: The Cafe Window
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly only for the woman’s facial identity and natural features. Preserve her face shape, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, and overall likeness accurately. Keep her natural hair color from the reference, but style it as described below.
Create a high-resolution traditional blue ballpoint pen (Biro) illustration on lightly textured warm off-white paper, in a vertical 4:5 composition. The image should look hand-drawn with refined navy-blue ink linework, realistic pen pressure variation, delicate contour lines, dense cross-hatching, and visible paper grain. Add a subtle warm sepia/golden sunlight tint entering from the right side, blending naturally with the cool blue ink shadows.
Show the woman seated at a wooden café table in a three-quarter side composition. Her body is angled slightly toward the left while her face is turned toward the right, gazing pensively out of frame with a quiet, thoughtful expression. One elbow rests on the tabletop and the matching hand gently supports her cheek and chin; her other arm rests naturally across her lap. Her pose should feel relaxed, candid, and emotionally reflective.
Give her a messy loose bun/updo with fluid overlapping ink strokes, softly textured strands, and a few natural loose tendrils around her temples, cheeks, and neck. She wears a loose dark short-sleeve t-shirt and dark pants, rendered with rich near-solid navy ink, deep folds, and dense multidirectional cross-hatching. Keep her face softly luminous with sparse fine hatching, expressive eyes, defined lashes, natural brows, a straight nose, and softly parted full lips.
In front of her, place an open spiral-bound notebook on the wooden plank table. Fill the pages with small illegible handwritten notes and abstract sketches only, with no readable words. Add a small geometric triangle-like diagram on one page and a dark blue pen placed diagonally across the notebook. To the right, include an open zippered pencil pouch with several pens visible inside. Behind the notebook, place a white ceramic coffee mug on a saucer with a small spoon and subtle rising steam drawn using thin, soft negative-space lines.
Use visible wood grain, plank gaps, and linear hatching across the tabletop, with the warm sunlight becoming more prominent toward the right edge. Seat her on a slatted wooden chair with curved ink hatching and realistic structure.
Create a softly detailed café background: a bright window on the right as the source of warm light, wooden cabinetry and potted plants on the left, a hanging plant or pendant lamp above, and a distant café guest seated with their back turned near the window. Keep all background elements lighter, softer, and less densely drawn than the woman and table objects, creating natural atmospheric depth and focus separation.
The woman, notebook, mug, and pencil pouch should have crisp, high-contrast, highly detailed blue ink lines. The background should remain airy and understated. Let the portrait and surrounding linework softly dissolve and fade into the paper around all four outer edges of the composition, especially near the corners and border, so the image blends naturally into the off-white paper instead of ending with hard defined edges. No photorealistic colors, no painted brushstrokes, no cartoon look, no thick black outlines, no readable text, no distorted hands, no extra fingers, no overly smooth skin.

prompts.title: Man in Suit Sketch Prompt
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face matching and identity reference. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, eye shape, nose structure, sharpness, grooming, and natural asymmetry.
Pose & Composition
Subject is seated upright with a straight spine.
Neck perfectly straight, head level and centered, facing directly forward.
Aspect ratio: 4:5.
Framing: Upper-chest to slightly above head shot.
Face centered, head occupying approximately 75–80% of the frame.
Minimal upper shoulder visibility. 
Expression:
Neutral intense expression, eyes directly at camera, lips closed, subtle tension in eyes and brow.
Hair:
Hair is thick and natural with realistic flow, slight irregularity, believable strand direction using sharp ink strokes. Rendered with fine directional strokes, maintaining skin texture through linework.
Outfit:
He wears a tailored black suit blazer (worn open) over a crisp white button-down dress shirt with a slim black tie.  matte fabric, subtle folds near neck and shoulders, rendered using cross-hatching (not flat black fill).
Style:
Ultra-detailed black-and-white ink engraving illustration. Heavy cross-hatching and line-based shading, varied stroke density and direction to define facial planes, scratch lines, etched strokes, and raw ink texture for a hand-drawn feel. Subtle bottom splash effect applied to the lower edge of the portrait to smoothly fade shoulders into background.
Lighting:
Strong chiaroscuro using line density (no gradients). One side of face slightly darker, deep shadows under cheekbones, jawline, eye sockets, and neck. No soft lighting.
Background:
Clean off-white with minimal ink splatter around edges only. No environment.
Camera & Lens:
Eye-level camera angle, 85mm perspective.
Avoid:
Anime, cartoon, soft shading, gradients, 3D, CGI, photorealism, color, glow, blur, smooth skin, beautified face, generic face, over-stylized hair, perfect symmetry, detailed background, logos, text, accessories, vector art.

prompts.title: Waves of Thought
prompts.prompt:
Create a premium ultra-detailed monochrome line-art portrait of the uploaded subject in a dense hand-drawn engraving and topographic contour style. The final image must look like a luxury editorial portrait illustration, not a simple vector sketch.

Composition:
Create a tight bust-length portrait in a vertical 4:5 aspect ratio. The subject should fill most of the frame from upper chest to head, with the head large and prominent. Keep the subject centered and slightly turned in a subtle three-quarter pose, while the face remains mostly front-facing. The head is upright, posture composed, shoulders relaxed, and the portrait feels calm, confident, elegant, and premium.

Expression:
The subject should not look sad, tired, angry, or emotionally heavy. Keep the expression calm, confident, pleasant, composed, and naturally self-assured. Eyes should look softly forward or slightly off-camera with a refined, alert, dignified presence. Lips should be closed with a neutral-to-subtle pleasant expression, not downturned.

Subject details:
Adapt the facial structure naturally to the uploaded subject, suitable for any person of any age. Preserve the person’s natural face shape, hairstyle, facial hair if present, brow shape, nose structure, lips, jawline, ears, and overall personality. Make the face realistic and highly dimensional using only flowing contour lines. Do not beautify the subject into a generic model. Do not make the subject younger, older, sadder, or more stylized than necessary.

Facial linework:
The entire face must be sculpted with dense flowing cross-contour lines that wrap around the anatomy like topographic map lines. Use line direction and spacing to describe the forehead, brow ridge, eyelids, under-eye area, nose bridge, nostrils, cheeks, lips, chin, jawline, neck, and subtle expression lines. The face should have rich dimensional form, with shadows created only by tighter line density and highlights created by wider line spacing. No solid black fills and no grayscale shading.

Eyes:
Make the eyes one of the sharpest focal points. Render the eyelids, pupils, iris detail, under-eye contours, and brow structure with precise black ink linework. The eyes should feel alive, calm, and naturally expressive, not blank or cartoonish.

Hair:
Render the subject’s natural hairstyle with extremely dense, premium, layered ink strands. Hair should be detailed, polished, and dimensional, with visible directional flow, volume, hair mass, crown structure, side texture, hairline, and individual curved strand groups. Use darker, tighter line clusters in shadowed hair areas, but avoid flat black fill.

Clothing:
Dress the subject in a structured tailored blazer or formal jacket over an open-collar button-up shirt, regardless of the original casual clothing. The outfit should feel refined, timeless, and editorial. Show clear lapels, jacket seams, collar folds, shirt opening, fabric tension, shoulder structure, and chest-level garment detail. Render the blazer and shirt with very dense engraving-style hatching and crosshatching, creating a premium woven fabric texture. Clothing should look detailed and formal, not like a sweater or plain T-shirt.

Background:
Use a clean white background with abstract flowing contour-line formations around the head and shoulders. The background lines should look like smoke, vapor, organic waves, or topographic currents, but they must stay secondary to the portrait. They should blend naturally around the hair and shoulders without overpowering the subject. Keep the background elegant, minimal, and spacious, but not empty.

Line style:
Use ultra-fine black ink strokes with subtle line-weight variation. Combine continuous contour lines, fingerprint-like grooves, engraved hatching, and sculptural cross-contour mapping. The portrait should be built entirely through black line density, spacing, rhythm, and curvature. Use many more fine lines on the face, hair, jacket, and shirt than in a simple outline drawing.

Quality target:
The final artwork should look highly premium, intricate, museum-worthy, hypnotic, and editorial. It should feel like a master engraving mixed with modern generative topographic line art. Keep the portrait realistic, detailed, elegant, and visually rich.

Avoid:
Do not create a simple vector portrait.
Do not create sparse linework.
Do not make the subject too small in the frame.
Do not show too much torso.
Do not use casual sweater clothing.
Do not use flat black fills.
Do not use grayscale shading.
Do not make the expression sad, tired, angry, or melancholic.
Do not make the background more detailed than the face.
Do not turn the image into cartoon, anime, caricature, or minimal logo-style art.
Do not simplify the hair, face, blazer, or shirt.

prompts.title: Vintage Elegance
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed, soft graphite pencil portrait in a refined, classical illustration style, as if drawn by a master traditional artist on high-quality textured paper. The artwork must feel entirely hand-crafted — no digital or AI artifacts.

Subject:
A graceful woman in a vintage Victorian-inspired aesthetic. Delicate facial features, smooth skin tones, soft natural expression, slightly parted lips, and calm, elegant eyes looking back over her shoulder.

Pose (LOCK):
Upper-body portrait (chest-up). Body turned away from the viewer (~30–40°), with the back partially visible. Head turned back over the shoulder toward the viewer. Maintain natural neck curve and shoulder depth — no flat pose.

Styling & Details:
Wearing an ornate wide-brim hat decorated with large soft flowers and subtle foliage. Hair styled in a loose, elegant low bun with soft curled strands framing the face. Long delicate drop earrings with fine detailing.
Outfit features a high-neck vintage blouse with intricate lace patterns, ruffles, and soft fabric folds. Every fabric texture must be highly detailed yet soft.

Art Style (VERY IMPORTANT):
– Hyper-detailed graphite pencil shading
– Extremely soft gradients and smooth tonal transitions
– Fine linework with subtle pressure variation
– No harsh outlines, no cartoon feel
– Realistic skin shading using layered strokes
– Visible but refined pencil texture (paper grain slightly noticeable)
– Depth created through light and shadow, not contrast exaggeration

Lighting:
Soft diffused studio lighting from front-left, creating gentle highlights on face and smooth shadow transitions. No harsh shadows.

Background:
Clean, minimal, light gray paper background with subtle texture. No distractions.

Quality:
Extremely high detail, 8K-level precision. Every strand of hair, fabric fold, and ornament must feel carefully hand-drawn.
4:5 aspect ratio.

Negative Prompt:
No digital painting look, no AI artifacts, no over-sharpening, no plastic skin, no exaggerated contrast, no modern styling, no color — strictly monochrome graphite.

prompts.title: Rugged Restraint
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image ONLY for face and identity reference. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, skin tone, and natural features. Do not copy pose, expression, or composition from the reference image.
Create a highly detailed black-and-white hand-drawn portrait in a raw, expressive sketch style.

POSE & COMPOSITION (STRICTLY LOCKED)

The subject is standing upright, front-facing directly toward the camera, with a straight body alignment. Shoulders are level and relaxed, not angled or turned. The head is positioned naturally upright with only a very subtle tilt (not exaggerated), and the gaze is directed forward (slightly soft, not staring aggressively).

Framing is centered and symmetrical, with the subject placed exactly in the middle of the canvas. Composition includes head to upper torso (upper-chest visible). The pose must feel neutral, grounded, and stable — no dynamic angles, no leaning, no rotation, no profile or three-quarter view.

Expression should feel story-driven and introspective, not overly intense — a calm, thoughtful, slightly distant gaze that suggests emotion beneath the surface.
Hair is slightly dark, messy and natural, drawn with loose, energetic strokes that extend outward beyond the silhouette, creating a sense of movement and artistic chaos. Some stray lines should break the boundaries of the face and background for a dynamic, unfinished aesthetic.

Rendering style must be extremely detailed and tactile, using:
Dense cross-hatching and fine linework for shadows
Layered sketch strokes to build depth and texture
Strong contrast between light and shadow, especially around eyes, cheekbones, and jawline
Visible construction lines and sketch marks to maintain a raw, authentic feel

Facial details should be sharply defined:
Deep, realistic eyes with subtle reflections
Natural skin texture built through line density (not smooth shading)
Structured nose and defined lips with soft tonal transitions

Lighting should feel like a dramatic single-source studio light, creating bold highlights on one side of the face and deep shadow gradients on the other, enhancing dimensionality.

SHADOW DETAIL (IMPORTANT)
Add a soft but clearly visible shadow cast on one side behind the subject onto the background, aligned with the light direction. The shadow should be diffused yet structured, enhancing depth and realism.

Background is clean white with abstract sketch lines and scribbles radiating outward, blending into the subject’s hair and form, reinforcing the artistic and expressive mood.

BOTTOM FADE EFFECT (CRITICAL STYLE ELEMENT)
The subject’s body should gradually dissolve into loose sketch strokes toward the lower portion, fading from detailed rendering into incomplete, expressive lines.

NEGATIVE SPACE (IMPORTANT)
Maintain balanced negative space on all four sides. The subject must not touch the frame edges. Keep clear breathing room above the head, on both sides, and below the torso for a premium, gallery-style composition.

Style inspiration: fine ink/charcoal hybrid sketch, modern editorial illustration, raw and emotional, highly textured, imperfect yet intentional.

Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical
Ultra-high detail, crisp line quality, no blur, no painterly softness — strictly sketch-based rendering.

prompts.title: Cross-Hatched Profile
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly ONLY for face and identity reference. Preserve exact facial structure, proportions, eye shape, nose structure, jawline sharpness, grooming, and natural asymmetry.
Pose & Body Position:
Subject is seated upright (not leaning), with a straight spine and stable posture. Neck is perfectly straight and aligned vertically with the spine — no tilt, no rotation, no forward/backward bend. Head remains level and centered, facing directly forward.
Ultra-tight vertical portrait (4:5), crop from mid-neck to slightly above hair top, face centered, straight-on angle, head filling ~85–90% of frame, minimal upper shoulder visibility.
Neutral intense expression, eyes directly at camera, no smile, lips closed, subtle tension in eyes and brow.
Hair should be thick and natural with realistic flow, not overly stylized or inflated. Avoid perfect volume or “hero hair”. Maintain slight irregularity, weight, and believable strand direction using sharp ink strokes.
Outfit: Black minimal fitted high-neck clothing, matte fabric, subtle folds near neck and shoulders, rendered using cross-hatching (not flat black fill).
Style: ultra-detailed black-and-white ink engraving illustration. Heavy cross-hatching and line-based shading. Use varied stroke density and direction to define facial planes. Avoid uniform or repetitive patterns. Include scratch lines, etched strokes, and raw ink texture for a hand-drawn feel.
Lighting: strong chiaroscuro using line density (no gradients). One side of face slightly darker. Deep shadows under cheekbones, jawline, eye sockets, and neck. No soft lighting.
Details: subtle facial scars and scratch marks. If a beard is present in the reference image, it is rendered with fine directional strokes, and skin texture is defined through linework (not smooth shading).
Background: clean white with minimal ink splatter around edges only. No environment.
Avoid generic face generation. Preserve raw individuality from reference.
Negative prompt: anime, cartoon, soft shading, gradients, 3D, CGI, photorealism, color, glow, blur, smooth skin, beautified face, generic face, over-stylized hair, perfect symmetry, detailed background, logos, text, accessories, vector art

prompts.title: Cross-Hatched Mind
prompts.prompt:
Create an 8K highly detailed head-and-neck portrait illustration of a person using the provided face reference. Preserve the exact facial proportions, identity, and unique features without alteration.
Composition:
The frame must include only the head and neck, tightly composed and perfectly centered. Maintain balanced negative space around the head and hair. The subject is looking directly into the camera with a strict eye-level, front-facing angle (no tilt). Expression should be calm, composed, and neutral.
Art Style:
Render the artwork as a raw, chaotic ink-style poster, constructed primarily from dense, curved black scribble strokes. The reference image is used strictly for accurate structure and likeness—do not stylize beyond recognition.
Line Work & Form:
Build hair, facial shadows, and depth using layered, overlapping, uneven lines
Incorporate rough cross-hatching techniques
Lines should feel organic, tangled, expressive, and slightly imperfect
Embrace a sense of controlled chaos and hand-drawn energy
Color Palette (Strictly Minimal):
Skin: flat beige tone only (no gradients, no realism)
Structure & shading: deep black ink strokes only
No smooth blending or polished rendering
Stylistic Details:
Introduce slight asymmetry in line flow for a natural, raw feel
Surround the subject with an irregular, abstract, tangled aura made of loose scribbles
Enhance the chaotic energy while maintaining structural clarity
Background:
A solid, flat, vibrant orange background, clean and uniform, creating strong contrast with the black ink work
Lighting:
Lighting should be implied only through line density—do not use realistic lighting or shading techniques
Overall Look:
High-contrast, graphic, poster-like aesthetic with a raw, expressive ink illustration style
Strictly Avoid:
No outfit visible
3D effects
Realistic rendering
Gradients
Soft shading
Any polished or clean digital finish
Style Direction:
Expressive ink illustration / raw sketch poster / abstract line-art portrait
Output Quality:
8K resolution
Aspect Ratio: 4:5

prompts.title: Splattered Noir
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image as a strict identity reference. The subject’s facial structure, proportions, skin tone, eye shape, nose, jawline, lips, hairline, hairstyle, and beard density must remain 100% identical. No beautification, no stylization drift, no identity alteration.

Create a high-contrast black-and-white neo-noir ink illustration portrait with a gritty, intense cinematic mood.

Composition & Framing

Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical

Framing: Tight head-and-neck portrait (slightly below collarbone visible)

Subject fills ~80–85% of the frame

Face is centered but not perfectly flat — very slight natural asymmetry

Pose & Head Position (FIXED)

Head is facing forward but subtly turned a few degrees to the subject’s left (viewer’s right)

Chin is slightly lowered, creating a mild downward intensity

One side of the face appears very slightly more dominant due to angle, not perfectly symmetrical

Shoulders are minimally visible and slightly angled, not squared flat

Overall pose feels grounded, natural, and slightly leaning forward into frame

Eye Direction & Expression

Direct eye contact, but with a slightly narrowed, focused gaze
Eyes are not wide — subtle intensity with relaxed eyelids
Expression remains serious, calm, and controlled
Hair & Beard
Thick, slightly voluminous hair styled naturally with subtle forward flow
Visible strand detailing with ink strokes
Short, rugged beard with realistic density and sharp edges
Must match reference exactly (no trimming or redesigning)
Style & Rendering
Ultra-detailed ink illustration / engraving style
Heavy use of cross-hatching, fine linework, and scratch textures
High micro-detail in skin, beard, and hair
Visible hand-drawn imperfections, sketch lines, and etched shading
Graphic novel / neo-noir aesthetic, not photorealistic
Lighting
Dramatic high-contrast chiaroscuro lighting
Strong shadows defining cheekbones, jawline, and eye sockets
Bright highlights on forehead, nose bridge, and cheek planes
Deep blacks in hair, beard, and shadow regions
Background
Clean white background with black ink splatter effects
Random ink drops, streaks, and scratch marks around the subject
Minimal but gritty, enhancing the raw illustrated feel
Clothing
Dark, formal outfit (black suit, white shirt)
Subtle linework detail, not distracting from face
Quality & Finish
Ultra-sharp, highly detailed
Crisp edges, no blur
Professional editorial illustration quality
Negative Prompt (Strict)
anime, cartoon, 3D, CGI, soft shading, smooth skin, glow effects, blur, low contrast, color, warm tones, painterly, watercolor, oil painting, photorealism, smiling, open mouth, exaggerated features, distorted anatomy, different hairstyle, clean digital airbrush style, glossy skin

prompts.title: Intense Assassin
prompts.prompt:
Hyper-realistic, dramatic black-and-white neo-noir assassin portrait illustrated in an ultra-detailed ink engraving / cross-hatching style.
Composition & Framing
Vertical 4:5 portrait.
Subject positioned on the left with 0% margin. occupies approximately the left 60–65% of the canvas.
The right 35–40% must remain clean white negative space.
Approximately 2/3 of the face is visible, cropped vertically through the centre of the eye.
Framing is a tight cinematic close-up:
• top crop slightly mid hair
• bottom crop just above the upper shoulder
Face orientation is almost straight toward the viewer, with a very slight forward angle.
The eyes must be the strong focal point.
Subjects Hair Styling (Corrected Fix)
Detect the user's hairstyle in the uploaded image and rebuild it with the same level of extreme detail as the assassin artwork, focusing on natural thickness and texture, not simplified or well-groomed.
Hair must appear:
• Natural thick, layered hairstyle (not thin or short)
• Dark colour
• High-volume, dynamic messy flow
• Slightly wet affected
• Highly textured with slightly meticulous individual strand rendering
• Large side-swept shape
Hair rendering requirements:
• Flowing hair with extreme detail
• Dynamic messy flow
• Subtle Individual, flowing hair strands meticulous rendering
• Loose strands falling naturally across the forehead
The hair should feel slightly wet and intense, like a noir action character, created with extreme attention to detail.
Beard Enhancement (Critical Fix)
Detect facial hair from the uploaded image and convert it into a rugged assassin beard texture.
Rules:
If clean shave → add light rugged stubble
If stubble → convert to short dense stubble
If beard → intensify beard density and texture with high volume
Beard rendering must include:
• visible hair strokes
• cross-hatched beard shadows
• strong jawline definition
• natural beard thickness
Beard must feel raw and masculine, not perfectly groomed.
Skin Texture
Add subtle gritty elements:
• light scars
• scratches
• ink splatter marks
• rough skin texture
Skin shading must use dense cross-hatching, not smooth gradients.
This creates a battle-hardened assassin aesthetic.
Lighting
Extreme noir chiaroscuro lighting.
• One side of the face has deep shadow due to the lighting effect
• other side strong illumination
Shadows formed by dense ink hatching.
Contrast must be very high.
Illustration Style
Ultra-detailed ink-engraving illustration.
Visible:
• cross-hatching
• ink scratches
• line textures
• rough engraving strokes
Inspired by:
• noir graphic novels
• vintage engraving art
• crime thriller posters
Background must remain clean white with large negative space.
Mood
Dark, brutal, cinematic assassin character.
Expression intense, dangerous.
